grammar.silhouette: Off-axis strained machine with a single large stepped pawl catching its bearing.
grammar.motion: Uneven slips/misses, decisive pawl contact, a short stutter catch and restrained settlement.
grammar.location: One side of the low bearing and contact-floor scrape.
grammar.persistence: Intermittent actual danger window; bounded successful-contact catch.
grammar.palette: Dull steel/brass, small gold tooth tips, oxide strain marks and one pale catch flash.
grammar.feature: Asymmetric toothed L-shaped pawl and leaning bit; no recovery-ring expansion or relaunch.

notes: Rank II adds a second small staggered bearing stop, not a surrounding symmetric clamp.
The authored catch never resets the physical player, reserve, collision radius or position.
source_direction_contract: Upright artwork; heading suffix chooses pre-authored screen-direction placement e/ne/n/nw/w/sw/s/se. No runtime rotation of isometric art.
authoring: Distinct pixel-cluster compositions and deliberate key poses assembled as normal editable native Aseprite layers. Scripted authorship, not manual mouse painting. Saved masters are the editing authority.

review_tier.after: B/A candidate pending full roster, grayscale and motion review

card_story: Twelve unequal-duration keys: anticipation, action, mechanical reaction, follow-through and intentional reset. Not six arbitrary cycling decorations.
